key_findings.claim: WithAll’s Keys in Bloom Gala: Possible fit. WithAll shows strong alignment with eating-disorder support and prevention. However, its Minnesota gala does not meet the current request for Manhattan business sponsors.

National Eating Disorders Association Gala 2026: Possible fit. This is the most relevant source for discovering potential Manhattan sponsor leads, but it is not itself a business sponsor. The snippet’s business names are useful research leads only, not confirmed prospects or evidence of willingness to support the foundation.

Project Blackbird Gala: Possible fit. Project Blackbird’s stated anti-stigma mission aligns strongly with the foundation’s mental-health and eating-disorder purposes. Its Washington, D.C. gala does not supply verified Manhattan business sponsor prospects.

NEDA Annual Gala: Needs research. This is an unverified research lead rather than an actionable sponsorship opportunity. It may help locate historical business supporters, but the supplied material is insufficient to assess mission fit or local relevance.
